messages:
frank: putting this here after the architecture sync 00 we need a compact spec for canary + auto-fallback that avoids oscillation and keeps billing predictable per-tenant.
olivia: agree. pattern we keep circling back to: local fast decisioner + global safety caps.
pat: concrete idea: decisioner runs a tiny deterministic state machine per-tenant that consumes signals (p95, in-flight-queue, kv-hit, recent-fallbacks) and emits an action: allow, hedge, fallback-to-X, or block.
meera: signals list: sliding-window p95 (20s), token-rate, queue-length, model-quality-flag (from small eval set), and fallback-count in last 5m.
frank: to prevent flip-flopping: require "stability window" semantics. only transition to fallback if condition holds for Xs and then enforce cooldown of Ys. also cap fallbacks per-minute with a leaky-bucket.
olivia: fallback ordering: prefer same-family lower-precision -> siblings with KV affinity -> cached-last-good -> synthesized short answer. do not cross-family unless explicitly allowed.
pat: add monotonic fallback generation id so retries see same choice. makes logs and debugging sane.
meera: policy surface for routes should be tiny: budget_ms, fallbacks (ordered list), stability_s, cooldown_s, max_fallbacks_per_min. sample: {route:"/v1/complete", budget_ms:"150", fallbacks:["rwi-8q","rwi-6b-q"], stability_s:"3", cooldown_s:"30", max_fallbacks_per_min:"10"}
frank: memory concern: per-tenant state grows. store only hot tenants in LRU; cold tenants consult control-plane defaults. expose tunable limit.
olivia: cache priming: async prefix-KV warmup triggered when fallback chosen and warmup budget available. do not block main request unless explicit opt-in.
pat: session affinity matters for many customers. we should prefer co-located fallback nodes to preserve KV continuity. if that can't be satisfied, return cached-last-good with X-warning header.
meera: telemetry: structured events with reason codes: capacity, latency_spike, quality_regression, operator_override, probe_timeout. include tenant_id, route, model_version, fallback_id, and estimated token-delta.
frank: rollout: 1) dry-run/observe-only in stage region for 2 weeks; 2) opt-in internal tenant for 72h; 3) small external cohort. gather metrics: fallback-rate, latency-quantiles, cost-delta, quality-regressions.
olivia: ops thresholds: page if fallback-rate >1% sustained 15m OR >400 fallbacks in 10m OR quality_regressions >3 in 30m. auto-rolloff toggle in console.
pat: simulator: must prove non-oscillation under bursty arrival patterns. we need a tiny sim harness in RFC with knobs for capacity drop, warmup-delay, and affinity-loss.
meera: policy DSL must be intentionally small: condition predicates on sliding-window metrics only; actions limited to route-to/fallback-order/hedge-percent/no-op. evaluation must be O(1).
frank: audit: every auto-fallback writes immutable event with pre/post routing state, policy-version, and operator tags. retention policy per-enterprise.
olivia: testing: unit sims for hysteresis, integration tests for affinity-preserving chosen path, chaos test with region outage.
ci-bot: rollout job queued: canary/auto-fallback-v1 -> canary region start 2026-06-01T08:00:00Z
pat: next PRs: (A) add signals + structured logging (B) implement decision-state machine + LRU tenant store (C) control-plane policy push + caps (D) opt-in rollout.
meera: include cost-accounting per-event so finance can model impact.
frank: good notes. I'll draft the RFC and include the sim harness, sample DSL, and playbook. closing thread here, will link RFC when ready :thumbsup:
